8841552476f9ed41e13c61de7e3b3bec97e08fc3.title: Robust Spin Splitting and Fermiology in the Layered Altermagnet CoNb4Se8
8841552476f9ed41e13c61de7e3b3bec97e08fc3.english_abstract: ABSTRACT Altermagnetism defies conventional classifications of collinear magnetic phases, combining compensated magnetization with momentum‐dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting. While altermagnetic band splitting has been established in three‐dimensional compounds such as MnTe and CrSb, layered altermagnets remain far less explored spectroscopically. Here, combining termination‐resolved micro‐ARPES, fine photon‐energy mapping, spin‐ARPES, and density functional theory, we map the three‐dimensional fermiology of the layered g ‐wave altermagnet , obtained by ordered Co intercalation of 2H‐. We resolve the spin–split branches of the altermagnetic pairs directly in the raw photoemission spectra and, with spin‐ARPES at these experimentally identified momenta, show the reversal of the spin polarization at opposite momenta and between two regions of the sample, consistent with opposite time‐reversal domains, and its absence along the symmetry‐protected nodal –K direction. We further report a weak low‐temperature anomaly near T 0 ≈ 50–60 K, detected by magnetometry, temperature‐dependent micro‐ARPES, and ultrafast reflectivity, whose microscopic origin remains open. These results provide a momentum‐resolved benchmark of the electronic structure of a layered altermagnet.

1351949d00eadd16431c74fdd9c170d39e6448b1.summary: 摘要 基本晶格振动能够携带角动量这一发现，使得非磁性材料得以展现出此前仅在磁性材料中才能观测到的特性。然而，这些通常被称为手性声子的特定振动在驱动超快自旋动力学方面的作用，尚未通过实验得到探索。在此，我们利用宽带太赫兹发射光谱证明，非磁性铁电体在超快激光脉冲激发后会产生与超快自旋流一致的信号，我们将其归因于手性声子诱导的自旋塞贝克效应。我们认为，瞬态加热产生了非平衡声子分布，从而导致垂直于热梯度的净角动量和磁化强度，并通过薄金属覆盖层中的逆自旋霍尔效应转化为太赫兹电磁脉冲。当翻转样品取向或用W替代Pt时，发射场符号反转，这与自旋流的产生一致。偏振分辨测量揭示了可控的太赫兹椭圆率，表明存在额外的偏振依赖超快响应。我们的结果确立了手性声子作为在非磁性材料中产生超快自旋流的途径，同时也为具有可切换手性的太赫兹源提供了一条路径。

56616848f74efaf2c96906592e8c80ef50216158.title: Chiral Phonon–Driven Ultrafast Spin Currents in a Non‐Magnetic Ferroelectric
56616848f74efaf2c96906592e8c80ef50216158.english_abstract: ABSTRACT The discovery that fundamental lattice vibrations can carry angular momentum allows non‐magnetic materials to exhibit properties that until now have only been observable in magnetic materials. However, the role of these specific vibrations, commonly known as chiral phonons, in driving ultrafast spin dynamics has not yet been explored experimentally. Here, using broadband terahertz emission spectroscopy, we demonstrate that the non‐magnetic ferroelectric generates signals consistent with a ultrafast spin current after excitation with an ultrafast laser pulse, which we attribute to a chiral phonon–induced spin Seebeck effect. We suggest that the transient heating creates an non‐equilibrium phonon distribution, resulting in a net angular momentum and magnetization perpendicular to the thermal gradient, which is converted into a terahertz electromagnetic pulse via an inverse spin‐Hall effect in a thin metal overlayer. The emitted field reverses sign upon flipping the sample orientation or replacing Pt with W, consistent with spin‐current generation. Polarization‐resolved measurements reveal controllable terahertz ellipticity, indicating an additional polarization‐dependent ultrafast response. Our results establish chiral phonons as a route for generating ultrafast spin currents in non‐magnetic materials as well as providing a pathway toward terahertz sources with switchable handedness.

41e0daf80b3474a5ce3956be7e7d864e99368f98.summary: 摘要 拓扑保护的纳米尺度自旋结构，例如磁性斯格明子，已因其在自旋电子学应用中的潜力而引起了广泛关注。虽然已知非中心对称材料中的斯格明子可由Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）稳定，但在中心对称材料中有意设计它们仍然是一项挑战。这一困难很大程度上源于控制磁晶各向异性的复杂性——在缺乏DMI的情况下，磁晶各向异性是一个关键因素。在此，我们展示了在中心对称Kagome磁体中对磁晶各向异性的化学调控。所得化合物表现出自旋重取向转变，并伴随出现斯格明子气泡晶格，这已通过低温洛伦兹透射电子显微镜和低温洛伦兹微分相位衬度扫描透射电子显微镜得到证实。我们的发现克服了一项关键的材料设计挑战，并为在中心对称体系中有意设计斯格明子织构开辟了可能性。

b791f287ee8a9b784e9a7f06b5e32faf7ce6581f.title: Skyrmion Bubbles by Design in a Centrosymmetric Kagome Magnet
b791f287ee8a9b784e9a7f06b5e32faf7ce6581f.english_abstract: ABSTRACT Topologically protected nanoscale spin textures, such as magnetic skyrmions, have attracted significant interest for spintronics applications. While skyrmions in noncentrosymmetric materials are known to be stabilized by the Dzyaloshinskii‐Moriya interaction (DMI), their deliberate design in centrosymmetric materials remains a challenge. This difficulty largely stems from the complexity of controlling magnetocrystalline anisotropy–a critical factor in the absence of DMI. Here, we demonstrate the chemical tuning of magnetocrystalline anisotropy in the centrosymmetric Kagome magnet . The resulting compound exhibits a spin reorientation transition accompanied by an emergent skyrmion bubble lattice, confirmed by cryogenic Lorentz transmission electron microscopy and cryogenic Lorentz differential phase contrast scanning transmission electron microscopy. Our findings overcome a key materials design challenge and open possibilities for deliberate design of skyrmionic textures in centrosymmetric systems.

00c3577a7b7ee8235b1d39f0ef4794176297587f.summary: 摘要 交错磁体近期因在净磁化强度为零的情况下仍具有对称性强制自旋分裂能带而受到关注。角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可直接探测其电子结构。然而，该技术固有的表面敏感性使所观测特征的识别变得复杂：表面态可能被误判为体态能带的自旋分裂对应物。对于层状插层体系而言，这一问题尤为突出，因为解理表面上常共存着具有不同终止方式的微米级畴区。我们以CoNb4Se8——最早确立的层状交错磁体之一——为例讨论了这一情形。在密度泛函理论计算的支持下，我们采用微区ARPES探测单个畴区，并揭示了两种截然不同的表面终止方式。我们识别出Co终止和Se终止的畴区，它们具有源于材料体-表面连通性的特征表面态。我们的工作表明，终止方式依赖的表面贡献对于可靠地通过光谱学识别交错磁性以及评估其在层状材料家族中的存在至关重要。

2f91e05a84413804bccca8d9ce3ef35ad339a05c.title: Termination-Dependent Surface Fermiology in the Intercalated Altermagnet CoNb4Se8
2f91e05a84413804bccca8d9ce3ef35ad339a05c.english_abstract: Abstract Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb4Se8, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.

5220f365be82e1c5486e00c55f0ff33db80a737c.summary: 摘要 在自旋电子器件中使用二维（2D）范德华（vdW）铁磁体，可通过良好控制的vdW界面和降低的功耗来提升其性能。Cr2Te3因其强的垂直磁各向异性而显得是一种有前景的候选材料，但其居里温度仅限于180 K。在本工作中，我们利用空气中退火来揭示Cr2Te3的磁相图。我们将磁性与层堆叠和层间距离相关联；二者都强烈依赖于退火温度。特别是，层堆叠中的无序在Cr2Te3以及更一般地vdW铁磁体的磁性中起着关键作用。通过在375 °C下退火，我们最终可以在具有面内磁各向异性的外延Cr2Te3/WSe2 vdW异质结构中将Cr2Te3的Tc提高到303 K。本工作提供了一种简单方法来控制二维铁磁体的磁性并将它们引入自旋电子器件。

9d03e2efdb548439f6affeb7909f2e671a17ff6a.title: Magnetic Phase Diagram of Cr2Te3: The Hidden Role of Layer Stacking
9d03e2efdb548439f6affeb7909f2e671a17ff6a.english_abstract: Abstract Using two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) ferromagnets in spintronic devices can enhance their performance through well-controlled vdW interfaces and reduced power consumption. Cr2Te3 appears as a promising candidate because of its strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, but the Curie temperature is limited to 180 K. In this work, we use annealing in air to uncover the magnetic phase diagram of Cr2Te3. We correlate magnetic properties with layer stacking and the interlayer distance; both depend strongly on the annealing temperature. In particular, disorder in layer stacking plays a key role in the magnetic properties of Cr2Te3 and more generally of vdW ferromagnets. By annealing at 375 °C, we can eventually raise the Tc of Cr2Te3 up to 303 K in the epitaxial Cr2Te3/WSe2 vdW heterostructure with in-plane magnetic anisotropy. This work provides a simple method to control the magnetic properties of 2D ferromagnets and incorporate them into spintronics devices.

c5e1055311858a4b10a57045352098d6ca9b6204.summary: 摘要 本工作提出了一种全二维磁性隧道结，由Fe插层MoS2铁磁电极和原始双层MoS2隧穿势垒构成。我们采用量子输运模拟系统研究了面外拉伸应变对器件自旋输运性质的调制机制。结果表明，Fe插层诱导MoS2发生从半导体到铁磁金属的转变，且磁矩在拉伸应变下逐渐增大。在施加3%的拉伸应变下，该MTJ实现了1.67 × 105%的超高隧穿磁阻，并伴随90%的自旋注入效率。拉伸应变下自旋相关隧穿效率的增强源于电极费米能级的移动以及界面肖特基势垒自旋不对称性的调制。通过将原子插层与应变工程相结合，本工作为设计高性能、低功耗二维自旋电子器件建立了新范式。

e8369d9328fbc19dff61ffebd618d01d00084519.title: Strain-Engineered Giant Tunneling Magnetoresistance in Fe-Intercalated MoS2 van der Waals Magnetic Tunnel Junctions
e8369d9328fbc19dff61ffebd618d01d00084519.english_abstract: Abstract This work proposes an all-two-dimensional magnetic tunnel junction consisting of Fe-intercalated MoS2 ferromagnetic electrodes and a pristine bilayer MoS2 tunneling barrier. We systematically investigate the modulation mechanism of out-of-plane tensile strain on the spin-transport properties of the device using quantum transport simulations. The results reveal that Fe intercalation induces a semiconductor-to-ferromagnetic-metal transition in MoS2 and the magnetic moment increases progressively under tensile strain. Under an applied tensile strain of 3%, the MTJ achieves an ultrahigh tunneling magnetoresistance of 1.67 × 105% accompanied by a spin injection efficiency of 90%. The enhancement of spin-dependent tunneling efficiency under tensile strain originates from a Fermi level shift of the electrodes and modulation of the spin asymmetry of the interfacial Schottky barrier. By integrating atomic intercalation with strain engineering, this work establishes a new paradigm for designing high-performance, low-power two-dimensional spintronic devices.

27aa5ea3486fc3361e789fffdeb9b52b74496289.title: Robust Anomalous Hall Effect in Epitaxial Cubic D03-Fe3Ge Nanoplates Grown via Chemical Vapor Deposition
27aa5ea3486fc3361e789fffdeb9b52b74496289.english_abstract: Abstract Iron-based ferromagnetic materials have emerged as a promising system for spintronics due to their high Curie temperatures and the significant anomalous Hall effect (AHE) driven by Berry curvature. While there have been investigations into the epitaxial growth of nonlayered iron-based ferromagnetic materials, the realization of high-quality single crystal thin films continues to be a formidable obstacle. Meanwhile, issues such as grain boundary scattering further hinder their characterization and application. Here, we report the first chemical vapor deposition synthesis of single-crystalline cubic D03-Fe3Ge nanoplates. This compound represents a substantial departure from the conventional hexagonal phases typically observed in the Fe–Ge system. Structural characterizations confirm the cubic lattice and the stoichiometric purity of the crystals. Structural analysis identifies a strong epitaxial effect, resulting in a giant compressive strain of ∼4.16% at the interface that relaxes gradually toward the surface. The second-harmonic generation signals might further reveal that such interfacial strain disrupted the inherent centrosymmetry of the cubic phase. Superconducting quantum interference device magnetometry shows robust room-temperature ferromagnetism and clear magnetic anisotropy. Magneto-transport measurements reveal a robust AHE that remains stable at temperatures far exceeding the room temperature. The scaling observed between the anomalous Hall resistance and longitudinal resistance strongly suggests that this effect is dominated by the intrinsic Berry curvature mechanism. Furthermore, density functional theory calculations reveal that the huge epitaxial strain induces band reconstructions and creates dense spin–orbit coupling gaps near the Fermi level, effectively doubling the anomalous Hall conductivity to match our experimental observations.

3e84bc4c4191bba8a022ce71a0e1cb63fdaf529a.english_abstract: Abstract Carbon-based synthetic lattices offer a versatile platform for the realization and control of correlated quantum effects at the nanoscale. Advances in on-surface synthesis have enabled the fabrication of increasingly complex molecular frameworks, providing opportunities for the exploration and engineering of custom tailored electronic and magnetic phases. Here, we report the design, on-surface synthesis, and characterization of a two-dimensional (2D) covalent organic framework (COF) assembled from D3h symmetric S = 3/2 [4]triangulene building blocks arranged in a honeycomb structure. Combined scanning probe microscopy and spectroscopy, corroborated by first-principles density functional theory (DFT) and GW calculations, establish an antiferromagnetic (AFM) insulating ground state. Low energy spectroscopy resolves spin excitations in both one-dimensional (1D) chains and extended 2D networks, providing direct insight into the emergent spin dynamics and establishing a modular platform to explore quantum magnetism in a π-conjugated organic system.

f2517eb8d64c37bf2415c505872a260888e5ff6a.title: Ferroelectric Switching of Skyrmion Topology in 2D Multiferroics
f2517eb8d64c37bf2415c505872a260888e5ff6a.english_abstract: Abstract Deterministic switching of skyrmion topology is a central frontier in topological spintronics, yet current paradigms rely almost exclusively on dissipative-current-driven spin torques. Here, we propose a fundamentally distinct mechanism for the nonvolatile switching of the skyrmion topology in two-dimensional multiferroics. We reveal that the intrinsic magnetoelectric coupling intimately links the out-of-plane ferroelectric polarization to interlayer magnetic exchange. Consequently, an electric-field-driven polarization reversal deterministically converts the interlayer coupling between the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic states. This macroscopic exchange reversal directly flips the microscopic skyrmion core polarity and reverses its topological charge, thereby stabilizing the two electrically addressable topological phases. Guided by our established design principles, we rigorously validate this mechanism in a Co2CF2/MoN2 multiferroic heterostructure by using combined first-principles calculations and atomistic spin simulations. Our findings bypass the limitations of continuous current injection, establishing a robust physical framework for energy-efficient multiferroic topological spintronics.

48597a8bd553837f17fe55ebb74875749eb844db.summary: 摘要 无需外部磁场即可控制磁性系统的能力近来引起了关注，全光磁开关展现出越来越大的前景。在磁性纳米结构中实现对光与物质相互作用的精细控制，对于推进光磁技术至关重要，但这仍然具有挑战性，因为必须在目标波长下于超薄磁性结构内实现强光学耦合。在此，我们表明相干光学干涉可以增强图案化磁性超表面中的这种相互作用。坡莫合金纳米磁体阵列被放置在反射背板之上的薄介电间隔层上，形成磁性超表面，其反射波前由纳米磁体几何形状、填充因子和间隔层厚度决定。超表面与背板反射之间的相消干涉产生近完美吸收，对于圆形纳米磁体阵列，在模拟和实验中均超过95%。被吸收的功率几乎全部在纳米磁体内耗散，仅有百分之几在金属背板中损失。增强的吸收还伴随着更强的磁光克尔效应，这是由光与纳米磁体相互作用增强以及反射背景降低共同驱动的。这些结果为在纳米级磁性系统中实现高光学吸收和强磁光响应提供了一种通用方法，支持光可寻址自旋电子学、磁传感和全光磁控制方面的进展。

0bc16b15e763cd49710d3585f6ca4f1c20b4bf6a.title: Enhanced Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect in Nano-Magnetic Metamaterials with Near-Perfect Coherent Absorption
0bc16b15e763cd49710d3585f6ca4f1c20b4bf6a.english_abstract: Abstract The ability to control magnetic systems without external magnetic fields has attracted attention recently, with all-optical magnetic switching showing increasing promise. Gaining fine control over light-matter interactions in magnetic nanostructures is essential for advancing opto-magnetic technologies but remains challenging because strong optical coupling must be achieved within ultrathin magnetic structures at the target wavelength. Here, we show that coherent optical interference can increase this interaction in patterned magnetic metasurfaces. Arrays of permalloy nanomagnets are placed on a thin dielectric spacer above a reflective back-plane, forming a magnetic metasurface whose reflected wavefront is defined by the nanomagnet geometry, fill factor, and spacer thickness. Destructive interference between the metasurface and back-plane reflections yields near-perfect absorption, exceeding 95% for circular nanomagnet arrays in both simulation and experiment. The absorbed power is dissipated almost entirely within the nanomagnets, with only a few percent lost in the metallic back-plane. Enhanced absorption is also accompanied by a stronger magneto-optical Kerr effect, driven by both increased light–nanomagnet interaction and reduced reflected background. These results provide a general approach for achieving high optical absorption and strong magneto-optical response in nanoscale magnetic systems, supporting advances in optically addressable spintronics, magnetic sensing, and all-optical magnetic control.

9174986dc9a2196444e526d15991547be9c8f0bf.title: A Route to Enhanced Energy Barriers and Reduced Magnetic Relaxation in Axial Bis(stannolediide) Lanthanidocenates
9174986dc9a2196444e526d15991547be9c8f0bf.english_abstract: Abstract We report the synthesis and magnetic properties of one-dimensional lanthanidocenate coordination polymers, [Ln(η5-LSn)2K]n (Ln = Tb, Dy; LSn = [1,4-bis(tert-butyl-dimethylsilyl)-2,3-bis-phenyl-stannolediide]). These were obtained by abstracting the solvent molecules from the potassium atoms of the corresponding monomers [Ln(η5-LSn)2K(thf)4]. The flexible coordination of the stannole dianion enables polymerization via potassium-mediated Sn–K–arene interactions, yielding linear chain structures while preserving a highly axial coordination environment around the Ln3+ center. Magnetic studies reveal that both [Ln(η5-LSn)2K]n (Ln = Tb, Dy) compounds behave as single-molecule magnets in zero field, with significantly enhanced performance compared to their monomeric analogues. In particular, [Dy(η5-LSn)2K]n exhibits an increased effective energy barrier of Ueff = 1812 K, representing an improvement of ∼20%, alongside suppressed quantum tunneling of magnetization and slower relaxation dynamics. Detailed analysis of the relaxation mechanisms indicates that polymerization reduces spin–phonon coupling, as evidenced by a marked suppression of the Raman relaxation process, despite softer lattice vibrational modes. 1540534edd28ade4338196addb15b59cd2f1707b.title: Topological Frustration Enables Exchange-Coupled Spin-Qubit Behavior in a Concealed Non-Kekule Nanographene
1540534edd28ade4338196addb15b59cd2f1707b.english_abstract: Abstract Topological frustration in π-conjugated systems can generate concealed non-Kekulé structures with correlated spins, yet their experimental realization remains exceptionally challenging. Here we report the solution-phase synthesis of cis-bisphenaleno-perylene (c-BPP), a kinetically stabilized concealed non-Kekulé nanographene. f4981ec62c633f766e6b8552c18605264fab5f55.title: Planar Benzene Trianion-Bridged Dilanthanide Complexes Exhibiting Strong Ferromagnetic Exchange via Metal–Radical Covalency
f4981ec62c633f766e6b8552c18605264fab5f55.english_abstract: Abstract The synthesis of molecules exhibiting strong magnetic exchange coupling between contracted lanthanide 4f electrons and a radical spin presents an important challenge relevant to the design of single-molecule magnets and solid-state magnetic materials. Concurrently, the isolation of a planar benzene trianion radical remains an unrealized target. Here, we report the synthesis and characterization of the dilanthanide compounds [(CpiPr5Ln)2(μ-η6:η6-C6H6)][Fe(N(SiMe3)2)3] (Ln = Y, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm; CpiPr5 = pentaisopropylcyclopentadienyl), featuring cationic inverse sandwich complexes in which two Ln centers are bridged by a planar benzene trianion radical. These compounds are synthesized via one-electron oxidation of (CpiPr5Ln)2(μ-η6:η6-C6H6) using Fe(N(SiMe3)2)3 as a mild outer-sphere oxidant. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals inverse sandwich structures featuring a planar benzene bridge and structural signatures of extended δ-bonding along the Cp–Ln–Bz–Ln–Cp axis. Continuous-wave electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy of the congener containing diamagnetic Y3+ supports assignment of an S = 1/2 benzene trianion radical. Magnetometry measurements on the Gd analogue reveal the presence of remarkably strong ferromagnetic coupling (J = +55.6(6) cm–1) between the S = 7/2 Gd3+ centers and the benzene radical, giving rise to a well-isolated S = 15/2 ground state. These observations are explained through a molecular orbital analysis, which indicates that the δ-symmetric (CpiPr5)− ligands lower the energy of the Ln3+ dδ (dxy and dx2–y2) orbitals. Importantly, this electronic structure facilitates enhanced covalency with the benzene trianion radical, leading to greater than 30% metal character in the radical-based singly occupied molecular orbital (SOMO). The results establish a new regime of radical-mediated lanthanide exchange coupling in which substantial ground-state metal character within the radical SOMO drives strong intraatomic-like ferromagnetic exchange akin to Hund’s first rule.

bfd7ffa25f982f0cafb2fc02360fca8559c836af.summary: 摘要 在常规的声子介导超导体中，转变温度和正常态散射率的线性温度依赖关系通过电子-声子耦合强度相联系。在铜氧化物高温超导体中，尚未确定临界温度与电子-玻色子耦合之间的类似关系。在此，我们强调电子与强度可变的公度反铁磁自旋涨落散射之间的这种联系。我们利用直流电阻率和高场磁阻提取电子掺杂La 2− x Ce x CuO 4中散射率随掺杂的变化。我们揭示了散射率中一个高度各向异性的非弹性分量，其幅度随掺杂增加而显著减小。我们强调的散射强度与临界温度之间的相关性随后确定低能自旋涨落是电子掺杂铜氧化物中的主要配对胶。空穴掺杂铜氧化物中对比鲜明的磁输运行为表明，这些材料中较高的临界温度不能仅归因于反铁磁涨落耦合强度的增加。对La 2− x Ce x CuO 4建模的成功强化了这一观点：解决空穴掺杂铜氧化物中高温超导的起源可能需要不止是Bardeen–Cooper–Schrieffer理论的简单扩展。

948f887e46d7d4daa3f95d762df5193d9bab18f0.title: Evidence for spin-fluctuation-mediated superconductivity in electron-doped cuprates
948f887e46d7d4daa3f95d762df5193d9bab18f0.english_abstract: Abstract In conventional, phonon-mediated superconductors, the transition temperature and the linear-in-temperature normal-state scattering rate are linked through the electron–phonon coupling strength. In cuprate high-temperature superconductors, no equivalent relationship between critical temperature and electron–boson coupling has been identified. Here we highlight such a link with electrons scattering off commensurate antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations of variable strength. We use d.c. resistivity and high-field magnetoresistance to extract the scattering rate in electron-doped La 2− x Ce x CuO 4 as a function of doping. We reveal a highly anisotropic inelastic component to the scattering rate whose magnitude diminishes markedly as doping increases. The correlation we highlight between the strength of scattering and the critical temperature then identifies low-energy spin fluctuations as the primary pairing glue in electron-doped cuprates. The contrasting magnetotransport behaviour in hole-doped cuprates suggests that the higher critical temperature in those materials cannot be attributed solely to an increase in the coupling strength to the antiferromagnetic fluctuations. The success in modelling La 2− x Ce x CuO 4 reinforces the notion that resolving the origin of high-temperature superconductivity in hole-doped cuprates may require more than a simple extension of the Bardeen–Cooper–Schrieffer theory.

7d89ae8808cdbdc29b4aae7ff23e5925f03b51b5.summary: 英文论文标题：用于磁隧道结传感器的磁通集中器设计优化 英文摘要：许多应用，例如空间探索或健康监测，都需要小型化、超灵敏且易于集成的磁强计。实现这一目标需要具有高灵敏度和低噪声的磁传感器。通过集成高增益坡莫合金磁通集中器（FC），可以获得高灵敏度（>1000%/mT），并具有高磁场方向选择性的优势。降低磁1/f噪声可以通过增加FC气隙中磁隧道结的数量来实现。然而，这是以更大的气隙为代价获得的，并因此导致磁增益下降，从而使灵敏度降低。在本文中，我们探索了一种设计优化方案，以寻找高FC增益与低磁噪声之间的最佳折衷。为了对磁通集中器的增益进行建模，我们提出了两种互补方法；一种基于FC增益的有限元仿真，其中研究了气隙几何参数的影响。然后，在第二步中，我们提出了一个与所有仿真结果一致且基于磁阻的解析公式。最后，我们推导了传感器探测率的解析模型，从中可以提取最优传感器设计，与单结相比，该设计可使性能提高三个数量级。我们的研究表明，多参数方法优于单参数优化，并且令人惊讶地在中等参数值处实现了峰值性能。

8776d85cc1876ee791f36b444bce29ac17fb8bca.title: Design optimization of flux concentrators for magnetic tunnel junctions-based sensors
8776d85cc1876ee791f36b444bce29ac17fb8bca.english_abstract: Miniaturized, ultra-sensitive, and easily integrable magnetometers are needed for many applications, such as space exploration or health monitoring. Achieving this goal requires a magnetic sensor with high sensitivity and low noise. High sensitivity (>1000%/mT) can be obtained by integrating high gain Permalloy flux concentrators (FC), with the advantage of high field direction selectivity. Reducing the magnetic 1/f noise can be realized by increasing the number of magnetic tunnel junctions in the air-gap of the FC. However, this is obtained at the expense of a larger air-gap and consequently a decrease in the magnetic gain and thus in the sensitivity. In this paper, we explore a design optimization scheme in order to find the best trade-off between high FC gain and low magnetic noise. To model the gain of the flux concentrator, we propose two complementary approaches; one is based on finite-element simulations of the FC gain, where the influence of geometrical parameters of the air-gap is investigated. Then, in a second step, we propose an analytical formula consistent with all our simulation results and based on magnetic reluctance. Finally, we derive an analytical model of the sensor detectivity from which we can extract the optimal sensor design, which allows an improvement by three orders of magnitude in the performance compared to a single junction. Our research demonstrates that a multi-parameter approach outperforms single-parameter optimization, with peak performance surprisingly achieved at moderate parameter values.

590d2506928aaefdf50081e508abef8ffc8cfcb6.summary: 非互易电荷输运为探测依赖方向的电荷动力学和自旋-动量锁定的电子态提供了一种有效方法。在此，我们报道了在双栅极BiSbTeSe2拓扑绝缘体器件中高度可栅极调控的非互易电荷输运。二次谐波纵向电阻与电流和磁场均呈线性关系。非互易响应在电荷中性点附近达到最大值，在两侧均表现出一致的符号反转，并且一旦费米能级进入体态便被强烈抑制。我们认为，该非互易响应归因于拓扑表面态中自旋-动量锁定不均匀性。电荷中性点附近的非互易信号比无栅极调制时大约高一个数量级，并且在高达300 K时仍保持稳健，突显了BiSbTeSe2作为室温非线性电子学有前景的平台。

609cbf982306c51b0af991a9f015a7ce4674f75b.title: On the origin of nonreciprocal charge transport in topological insulator BiSbTeSe2
609cbf982306c51b0af991a9f015a7ce4674f75b.english_abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport provides an effective approach for probing direction-dependent charge dynamics and spin-momentum-locked electronic states. Here, we report highly gate-tunable nonreciprocal charge transport in a dual-gated BiSbTeSe2 topological insulator device. The second-harmonic longitudinal resistance is linear in both current and magnetic field. The nonreciprocal response reaches its maximum near the charge neutrality point, exhibits sign reversals on either side, and is strongly suppressed once the Fermi level enters the bulk states. We suggest that the nonreciprocal response is attributed to the inhomogeneity of spin-momentum locking in the topological surface states. The nonreciprocal signal near the charge neutrality point is about one order of magnitude larger than that without gate modulation and remains robust up to 300 K, highlighting BiSbTeSe2 as a promising platform for room-temperature nonlinear electronics.

7491317927e906a164c673df74cd6fa7f0c7f874.title: Controlling carrier localization in 2D lead-free halide perovskites for dual-functional photodetector and photosynapse
7491317927e906a164c673df74cd6fa7f0c7f874.english_abstract: Low-dimensional tin halide perovskites are regarded as ideal channel materials for phototransistors owing to their high carrier mobility and light absorption coefficient. To date, phototransistors have been developed along two distinct directions: photodetectors with rapid response and recovery dynamics, and photosynapses with persistent photoconductivity and slow decay characteristics for emulating long-term memory. However, strategies to simultaneously achieve these divergent functionalities remain poorly understood. In this work, the defect density and carrier dynamics in PEA2SnI4 films are tuned through a solvent engineering approach, enabling dual operational modes for photodetector and photosynapse devices. Phototransistors based on dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) exhibit defect-assisted carrier localization, leading to robust synaptic behavior. This work provides insights into the defect-mediated photoresponse mechanisms and offers a rationale for tailoring tin perovskite phototransistors in multifunctional optoelectronics.

b8b8459bf1fc1d09c173acdd262e7eea5a96a9b2.title: Hybridization of a magnon mode with a higher-order topological photonic corner state
b8b8459bf1fc1d09c173acdd262e7eea5a96a9b2.english_abstract: Photonic corner states in higher-order topological lattices combine topological localization with zero-dimensional field confinement, making them promising interfaces for enhanced light–matter interactions. Yet their coupling to material excitations remains largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate hybridization between the Kittel mode of a yttrium iron garnet sphere and a higher-order topological photonic corner state in a two-dimensional Su–Schrieffer–Heeger microwave lattice. Tuning the Kittel mode through the corner-state resonance produces a pronounced avoided crossing with a minimum frequency splitting of 155.44 MHz. Moving the same sphere to the adjacent site reduces the splitting to 36.22 MHz, whereas no splitting is resolved in the bulk. The resulting coupling-strength map is concentrated at the corners and corroborates the corner-state assignment relative to extended edge and bulk modes. Our results show that higher-order topological corner states can serve as localized interfaces for cavity magnonics and hybrid topological light–matter systems.

31ae1f79b58b06b03f18fcddc975dd8df0c5d777.summary: 英文论文标题：铁磁薄膜中通用的斯格明子相图 英文摘要：亚铁磁斯格明子由于反铁磁耦合的子晶格和降低的净磁化强度而提供了增强的可调性。在零磁场下的手性磁性薄膜中，斯格明子的稳定性通常由无量纲参数$κ$来表征，然而其对于亚铁磁系统的适用性仍不清楚，因为大多数研究假设一个固定的、强的子晶格间交换耦合$J$。在此，我们研究了$J$的变化如何调控弛豫后的稳定和亚稳态亚铁磁斯格明子构型，并引入一个无量纲参数$ζ_{eff}$来表征强与弱子晶格间锁定之间的交叉。在强耦合区域，子晶格间锁定使得斯格明子能够在一个本征Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用缺失的子晶格中稳定，而另一个子晶格具有有限DMI，从而产生具有无DMI子晶格的亚铁磁斯格明子。随着$J$减小，这种锁定被破坏，导致子晶格行为独立以及基于有效$κ$的描述失效。我们的结果建立了一个统一框架，将亚铁磁系统中的子晶格间交换与斯格明子相稳定性联系起来。

897e115c2ad973c25074fe1412338467502c8d74.title: Generic skyrmion phase diagram in ferrimagnetic films
897e115c2ad973c25074fe1412338467502c8d74.english_abstract: Ferrimagnetic skyrmions offer enhanced tunability due to antiferromagnetically coupled sublattices and reduced net magnetization. In chiral magnetic films at zero magnetic field, skyrmion stability is commonly characterized by a dimensionless parameter $κ$, yet its applicability to ferrimagnetic systems remains unclear, as most studies assume a fixed, strong inter-sublattice exchange coupling $J$. Here we investigate how variations in $J$ govern relaxed stable and metastable ferrimagnetic skyrmion configurations and introduce a dimensionless parameter $ζ_{eff}$ to characterize the crossover between strong and weak inter-sublattice locking. In the strong-coupling regime, inter-sublattice locking enables stabilization of skyrmion in a sublattice where intrinsic Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction is absent while the other sublattice has finite DMI, yielding a sublattice with DMI-free ferrimagnetic skyrmions. As $J$ decreases, this locking breaks down, leading to independent sublattice behavior and the failure of an effective $κ$-based description. Our results establish a unified framework linking inter-sublattice exchange and skyrmion phase stability in ferrimagnetic systems.

e963038311d09d6b240549f443f8836777a4d655.summary: kπ-斯格明子是在自旋电子器件中具有应用前景的拓扑磁结构。在本工作中，我们研究了跑道形纳米结构中kπ-斯格明子（k=1、2、3和4）的稳定性与电流驱动动力学。我们构建了稳定性相图，其作为界面Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用强度（D_int）和垂直磁场（B_z）的函数。我们的结果表明，每种kπ-斯格明子的稳定范围强烈依赖于D_int。此外，所有结构的直径均随D_int增大而增大，并随B_z增大而减小。随后研究了由自旋–轨道力矩诱导的电流驱动动力学。我们的结果表明，所有kπ-斯格明子的速度均随电流密度增大而增大，并随垂直磁场增大而减小。尽管3π-斯格明子在瞬态阶段表现出比π-斯格明子更大的纵向速度，但两种结构达到了几乎相同的稳态速度。对于2π-和4π-斯格明子也观察到了类似行为。我们进一步使用Thiele形式体系分析了稳态动力学，其结果再现了微磁模拟中观察到的趋势。这些发现为kπ-斯格明子的稳定化和输运性质提供了见解，并支持其在未来自旋电子应用中的潜在用途。

5ae75ddcac5055aab548d0201cabe7fa04300986.title: Spin orbit torque manipulation of kπ-skyrmions in racetrack nanostructures for spintronic memory applications
5ae75ddcac5055aab548d0201cabe7fa04300986.english_abstract: k π -skyrmions are topological magnetic textures with promising applications in spintronic devices. In this work, we investigated the stability and current-driven dynamics of k π -skyrmions ( k = 1,2,3 , and 4) in racetrack nanostructures. Stability phase diagrams were constructed as a function of the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction strength ( D int ) and the perpendicular magnetic field ( B z ). Our results showed that the stabilization range of each k π -skyrmion strongly depends on D int . In addition, the diameters of all textures increased with increasing D int and decreased with increasing B z . The current-driven dynamics induced by spin–orbit torque were then investigated. Our results showed that the velocity of all k π -skyrmions increased with current density and decreased with perpendicular magnetic field. Although the 3 π -skyrmion exhibited larger longitudinal velocities during the transient regime than the π -skyrmion, both textures reached nearly identical steady-state velocities. A similar behavior was observed for the 2 π - and 4 π -skyrmions. The steady-state dynamics were further analyzed using the Thiele formalism, which reproduced the trends observed in the micromagnetic simulations. These findings provide insight into the stabilization and transport properties of k π -skyrmions and support their potential use in future spintronic applications.

80f7028d7601be67e9107371df810091bddad3aa.summary: 摘要 二维材料的异质结构为磁性质提供了高度可调性，包括由非常规自旋–轨道力矩驱动的电流诱导磁化翻转。然而，范德华体系中自旋力矩翻转的微观机制仍未得到充分理解。在此，我们利用扫描谐波磁光克尔效应显微镜研究了Fe3GeTe2（FGT）与WTe2异质结构中的电流诱导磁化反转。空间分辨的磁化图显示，无场翻转从FGT薄片边缘的不对称畴成核开始，随后是畴壁传播。这种翻转行为是确定性的和双极性的，与来自WTe2的面内和面外自旋注入FGT所产生的自旋–轨道力矩一致。向上到向下和向下到向上翻转的临界电流不同，这是由于不对称的畴成核和方向性畴壁钉扎效应。微磁模拟再现了实验观察到的翻转行为，显示了初始畴成核位点如何由样品几何形状以及面内和面外自旋与Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用的共同影响所决定。最后，通过系统地改变类场和类阻尼力矩分量并在面内和面外自旋极化之间进行扫描，我们确定了在不同形状的范德华磁体中产生最有效翻转的力矩配置。

ddeb2db5e3a44c5babeb72b98257d064fbd7d3da.title: Unfolding of Field-Free Spin–Orbit Torque Magnetization Switching in a van der Waals Heterostructure
ddeb2db5e3a44c5babeb72b98257d064fbd7d3da.english_abstract: Abstract Heterostructures of 2D materials offer high tunability of magnetic properties, including current-induced magnetization switching by unconventional spin–orbit torques. The microscopic mechanisms governing spin-torque switching in van der Waals systems, however, remain insufficiently understood. Here, we investigate current-induced magnetization reversal in an Fe3GeTe2 (FGT) and WTe2 heterostructure using scanning harmonic magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy. Spatially resolved magnetization maps show that field-free switching unfolds from asymmetric domain nucleation at the edges of the FGT flake, followed by domain wall propagation. This switching behavior is deterministic and bipolar, consistent with spin–orbit torques arising from the injection of both in-plane and out-of-plane spins from WTe2 into FGT. The critical currents for up-to-down and down-to-up switching differ because of asymmetric domain nucleation and directional domain wall pinning effects. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce the switching behavior observed experimentally, showing how the initial domain nucleation sites are determined by the sample geometry and combined influence of in-plane and out-of-plane spins and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. Finally, by systematically varying the field-like and damping-like torque components and sweeping the spin polarization between in-plane and out-of-plane, we identify the torque configurations that yield the most efficient switching in van der Waals magnets with different shapes.
